notes: Copula placement follows rule 20's direction to read the Hebrew for which side is the predicate: תחלת חכמה is the fronted predicate of the first colon, so *is* joins it even though the ASV inverts that colon; in the second colon the ASV keeps the Hebrew order and בינה is the predicate that takes *is*.
No article morpheme stands anywhere in the verse, so every *the* is supplied and placed by rules 29 and 15; *One* is the generic expanding קדשים under rule 31, head on *Holy*.
